import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Handle missing values
train_df["comment_text"] = train_df["comment_text"].fillna("")
test_df["comment_text"] = test_df["comment_text"].fillna("")

# Target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Stratified split based on total toxicity rate
train_df["toxicity_score"] = train_df[target_cols].sum(axis=1)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["toxicity_score"]
)

train_sample = train_df.loc[train_idx]
val_sample = train_df.loc[val_idx]

print(f"Train size: {len(train_sample)}, Val size: {len(val_sample)}")

# TF-IDF Vectorizer
print("Vectorizing text...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    dtype=np.float32,
)

X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_sample["comment_text"])
X_val = vectorizer.transform(val_sample["comment_text"])
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

y_train = train_sample[target_cols].values
y_val = val_sample[target_cols].values

print("Training classifiers...")
# Train one classifier per toxicity label
classifiers = {}
predictions = {}

for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    clf = LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0,
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=100,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train[:, i])
    classifiers[col] = clf

    # Validate predictions
    predictions[f"pred_{i}"] = clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Calculate validation score (mean column-wise ROC AUC)
val_preds = np.column_stack([predictions[f"pred_{i}"] for i in range(len(target_cols))])
auc_scores = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[:, i])
    auc_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"{col}: {auc:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_predictions = {}
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    test_predictions[f"pred_{i}"] = classifiers[col].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "toxic": test_predictions["pred_0"],
        "severe_toxic": test_predictions["pred_1"],
        "obscene": test_predictions["pred_2"],
        "threat": test_predictions["pred_3"],
        "insult": test_predictions["pred_4"],
        "identity_hate": test_predictions["pred_5"],
    }
)

# Ensure correct order
submission = submission[["id"] + target_cols]

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Validation Mean ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")
